tax.text: She supports universal health care funded through progressive taxation.
tax.quote: I will fight to establish quality universal healthcare that is funded through progressive taxation.

wages.text: She supports stronger labor protections and collective-bargaining rights.
wages.quote: I’m also honored to serve as the Chair of the Senate Standing Committee on Labor, Public Employment and Retirement, where I guide efforts to uplift workers on issues relating to labor, industrial safety, unemployment, workers’ comp, collective bargaining, and public employee salaries, benefits, and retirement.

housing.text: She supported streamlined environmental review for infill housing and says state investments will create thousands of homes.
housing.quote: With fellow lawmakers, I helped pass legislation to streamline CEQA requirements for in-fill housing (SB 131) and protect the “Good Samaritan” right to provide food, water, bedding, shelter, and medical help to unhoused people (SB 634).

safety.text: She says public safety should emphasize services, opportunity, de-escalation, and crisis intervention rather than additional policing and incarceration.
safety.quote: Safety comes from services, opportunity, and combatting the root causes of poverty and inequity instead of leading with a surveillance and incarceration approach.

sentencing.text: She supports diversion, rehabilitation, reentry programs, and greater access to parole.
sentencing.quote: Our justice system should be centered around diversion, rehabilitation, fairness, de-escalation, crisis intervention, and law enforcement accountability.

immigration.text: She opposed ICE raids and advocated protections, dignity, and due process for immigrants regardless of status.
immigration.quote: We reaffirmed our commitment to ensuring that every person — regardless of immigration status — is treated with dignity and due process under the law.

guns.text: She called for prohibiting ghost guns and requiring universal background checks for gun-show and online firearm sales.
guns.quote: I will fight for common-sense gun-safety reform to include prohibitions on building ghost guns and requiring universal background checks on all firearms sales from gun shows and online retailers.

abortion.text: She supports maintaining California as a safe haven for abortion and reproductive-health services.
abortion.quote: And I am also a champion of keeping California a safe haven for people seeking reproductive healthcare and abortion services.

health.text: She supports universal health care modeled on Medicare for All and expansion of community clinics and public hospitals.
health.quote: We need to adopt a Medicare for All model if we want all Californian’s to thrive.

energy.text: She supports phasing out fossil fuels and investing in clean energy and green technology.
energy.quote: The State can and must phase out fossil fuels and invest in clean energy and green technology that also creates a new jobs-driven economy.

voting.text: She opposed proposed photo-identification and citizenship-proof requirements and supported stronger voter protections.
voting.quote: Our best defense to being silenced is to strengthen protections for all Californian voters

tax.text: Lisuzzo said he would eliminate California’s gas tax and preserve Proposition 13.
tax.quote: I would eliminate California’s gas tax completely. This would have an immediate impact on all Californians.

housing.text: Lisuzzo proposed reducing permitting and environmental requirements to accelerate low-cost housing construction.
housing.quote: To incentivize housing development and expedite projects, the state needs to reduce the red tape required to build. Also, eliminating exhausting environmental requirements statewide can quicken the process of building low-cost housing.

schools.text: Lisuzzo called for alternative school opportunities and reform rather than additional LAUSD funding.
schools.quote: Alternative school opportunities and reform is needed to help our children succeed. Did you know the budget for the LA unified school district is almost $19 BILLION per year!? This is not a money problem, it's a management problem that we must fix.

safety.text: Lisuzzo said law enforcement should always be funded and never defunded.
safety.quote: I also believe that law enforcement must always be funded and never defunded. This is the only way to abolish criminal cartels and guarantee public safety.

sentencing.text: Lisuzzo called for strong prosecution and punishment proportionate to the crime.
sentencing.quote: Society must ensure that criminals are strongly prosecuted for crime at every level and that victims of crime are never ignored.

immigration.text: Lisuzzo said California should cooperate with federal authorities on immigration enforcement.
immigration.quote: Accordingly, I believe that state government should work hand in hand with the federal government when it comes to “illegal anything.”

health.text: Lisuzzo opposed expanding state-subsidized coverage and said individuals should be responsible for obtaining health care.
health.quote: No, I would not support expanding state-subsidized healthcare programs, especially to those who are not legal U.S. citizens. I believe that healthcare is the responsibility of each individual to obtain, or not obtain, and not be provided “free” by the government.

energy.text: Lisuzzo criticized California’s climate goals and called for reversing restrictions affecting the oil industry.
energy.quote: Hence, I also believe there is an immediate need to reverse much of this legislation and many rules and regulations affecting California’s oil industry.
